```{r}
#| include: true
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
ID.target <- .resolveDerivedIDTarget(
  kmaxTable,
  "kh.qmd",
  suffix = ".max",
  target = Target,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
if (!exists("p.target"))   p.target   <- c(0.05,0.10,0.16,"mean", 0.84,0.90,0.95)
if (!exists("Da.target"))  Da.target  <- sort(Da.gmdp)
if (!exists("IDn.target")) IDn.target <- c("ensemble", "rigid", "flexible")
if (!exists("PSA_Units"))  PSA_Units  <- "cm/s2"
TR.label <- prettyNum(TR.gmdp, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- "Performance-based seismic coefficients $k_h$ in [%% PGA] as function of admissible residual displacement $D_a$ [cm] for geometry %s. Values are reported for target ground motion with 1/%.0f AEP [1/yr]."
```
